newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 16.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ended up 52.73 points at 7,975.71.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index ended 3.02 points lower at 1,012.48.
* Ringgit, which hit a 33-month low on Tuesday morning, continues to be weak, staying above 2.56 to a dollar on Wednesday morning
* Interest rates ease as big banks step in to lend, but overall liquidity remains tight.
* Dealers say volumes to remain low due to economic uncertainties arising from currency, interest rate crisis

* "Interest rates are coming down slightly, that should calm the market a little bit, but long-term fundamental scenario still does not look too good," said a dealer with a large retail-based brokerage.
* Analysts have said overheating fears in the Malaysian economy are expected to resurface due to a still large current account deficit, falling productivity and weak currency.
